plans.note: Only the preamble is exposed in the outline; a Master Services Agreement of this type will carry a limitation of liability article. Scan the full body for cap amount, mutuality and carve-outs (IP indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) before concluding.

Expect a vendor indemnity article in the MSA body. Confirm Kubient indemnifies AP for third-party IP infringement and its own negligence/misconduct, and that any AP-side indemnity is narrow (AP content/materials only).
Presence rule: no non-compete signalled in the outline. Search the body for any restriction on AP operating competing businesses or procuring similar ad-tech services; flag only if found.
Presence rule: check services/scope and term provisions for any exclusive-supplier or sole-source language binding AP; nothing surfaces in the visible outline.
Direction rule: look in pricing/fees provisions for most-favoured-customer language. MFN running to AP is acceptable; only an MFN obliging AP to give Kubient best terms is a deviation.
Presence rule: check general/miscellaneous and personnel provisions for a non-solicit binding AP; require narrow scope, 12-month limit and general-advertising carve-out if present.

Term and Termination article should exist given the defined term 'Initial Term'. Check whether AP may terminate for convenience on notice without penalty and whether Kubient has a reciprocal mid-term exit.
'Initial Term' is defined, so a renewal mechanic is likely in the Term article. Check auto-renewal length, non-renewal notice window and any price uplift.
Expect governing law/venue in the miscellaneous article; parties are New York-based, so New York courts are the likely and acceptable outcome. Confirm no foreign arbitration seat.
Assignment clause is standard in the miscellaneous article. Verify AP may assign to affiliates and successors without consent and that Kubient has no termination right on AP change of control.
Direction rule: locate the intellectual property/data article. Confirm AP retains ownership of its content, data and any paid-for deliverables, with no assignment of AP IP or data rights to Kubient.
Check the licence/right-to-use grant in the services or IP article for affiliate and contractor coverage and for any 'revocable at any time' language.

Parametric rule but audit rights against AP may not appear in an ad-tech MSA; scan fees/reporting and compliance provisions for vendor audit rights over AP usage, notice, frequency and cost allocation.
Direction rule: check fees/termination provisions for early-termination fees, penalties or liquidated damages payable by AP; service credits running to AP are fine.
Expect a warranties article (and possibly an SLA exhibit). Check duration of the performance warranty, the remedy offered, and the breadth of any 'AS IS'/disclaimer language.

Missing-check rule: search for an insurance article covering commercial general liability, errors and omissions and cyber; Kubient handles AP data, so it is expected. Flag as missing only if absent from the whole body and any exhibits.
Presence rule: review fees/order form or exhibit terms for minimum spend, take-or-pay or volume commitments binding AP; nothing visible in the outline.
Missing-check rule: look at effect-of-termination and data provisions for return/deletion of AP data and transition assistance; flag as missing if the body only covers deletion or is silent.
